about: Hand-labelled synthetic emails. Written after the intake prompt was final; none was used to tune it. Gold value null means the email does not state it, so the system must NOT produce it. 'ignore' lists fields where the right answer is a judgment call and are not scored. A gold value can be a list of acceptable spellings.

cases.subject: Urgent Delivery Delay - Store Launch
cases.body:
Hi Team,
Our supplier has informed us that 500 display units required for the Pune store launch will be delayed by 10 days. The store is scheduled to open next week, and only 120 units are currently available in the warehouse.

Regards, Regional Operations Manager
